Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Amelia, The Blood Red Tears

Camarilla: After combat with Amelia, the opposing minion burns 1 blood or life.

I have questions about she special.
1) if she burned or go torpor opposing minion still burns 1 blood or life,right?
2)if opposing minion by any way start new combat (psyche,or maybe by his special text) how much time opposing minion burns blood or life?
3) if after combat begin combat with another minion does both opposing minion burns 1 blood or life or only last who be in combat with she?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Amelia, The Blood Red Tears
>
> Camarilla: After combat with Amelia, the opposing minion burns 1 blood or life.
>
> I have questions about she special.
> 1) if she burned or go torpor opposing minion still burns 1 blood or life,right?
>
Her ability triggers after combat if she's still in play, even in torpor. If she is burned during combat, it doesn't trigger.

> beslin wrote:
> 2)if opposing minion by any way start new combat (psyche,or maybe by his special text) how much time opposing minion burns blood or life?
>
The opposing minion burns 1 blood or life each time the combat ends.

> beslin wrote:
> 3) if after combat begin combat with another minion does both opposing minion burns 1 blood or life or only last who be in combat with she?
>
Amelia is in combat with B. Combat ends => B burns 1 blood or life.
Then C enters in combat with A. Combat ends => C burns 1 blood or life.
In the case of Free Fight, it would be the last minion she was in combat with.
